text: Coffee with Sana and Rohan. Sana's pregnant, due sometime in the spring, and she's been really sick most mornings. Rohan has started building a cot himself, very proud of it. Remind me to send Sana that ginger tea brand next week.
Long catch-up with Pieter. He's finally joined a five-a-side league on Thursdays and keeps going on about Ajax. His sister Eva had her baby boy Friday, both doing well apparently.
Henrik rang. Christening for little Maja is end of the month, he'll confirm the date soon. Need to dig out something to wear.
Karim's into bouldering in a big way now, goes three times a week. His wife Neha thinks it's a phase lol. She's knitting a blanket for her cousin's baby, due early March.
Groceries, pharmacy, post the parcel to Mum before Friday.

Lunch with Chloe. She's 20 weeks and found out it's a girl! Her partner Luis is painting the nursery this weekend. Chloe said she'd love a decent baby carrier, worth remembering. Don't forget to ask her about the scan results next Tuesday.
Dmitri is reading his way through every Terry Pratchett book, on number 23. Says he'll lend me Guards! Guards! after Christmas.

Saw Aidan and his girlfriend Marta at the market. They're expecting! Due over the summer, not telling many people yet. Aidan seemed a bit overwhelmed honestly. Marta wants to keep doing her pottery class until she can't reach the wheel.
Erin's mum is having her hip done sometime next week. Erin's stressed, she's the one driving her back and forth. I should check in with her midweek.
Rin - massive Hanshin Tigers fan, follows every game on her phone at work. Plays shamisen too, been at it since she was a kid.

Hamza's baby shower got cancelled, his wife Sana Mensah was put on bed rest. They're fine, just being careful. Sana's sister Neha is staying with them for a couple of weeks to help out. Hamza's been coping by doing jigsaws at midnight, he's on a 2000-piece one of Venice. Must send them a food delivery tomorrow.

Quick one: Javier's band has a gig at The Crown in a fortnight. He's nervous, first time playing his own songs live. His girlfriend Rebecca is coming, and his parents are driving down from Leeds on the Friday. He's been rehearsing every night this week and says his voice is going. Text him good luck the day before.

Caught up with Joe after footy. His little girl Isla started nursery on Monday and cried for an hour, then loved it. His wife Rebecca is back at work in January and dreading it a bit. He's still obsessed with Warhammer, painting a whole army over the winter.
Paolo's partner Heather had twins on Saturday!! Two boys. Paolo sounded completely wrecked but happy. Need to organise a card from everyone at work.
Stefan said his brother Lukas is getting baptised as an adult, sometime in the new year. Bit unexpected. Stefan's going to be his sponsor.
I'm doing the cake for Neha's christening party, Sunday after next. Need to buy the fondant and a big tin.
Akira Tanaka, the new guy from upstairs, collects vintage film cameras. Has about forty. Wife's called Isabel, she's a midwife at the General.
Kemal mentioned his dog Simba got out again last night, found him two streets away. He's going to get the fence fixed this weekend.

Graham and his wife are expecting their first grandchild any day now. His daughter Erin is overdue by a week and fed up. He's checking his phone every five minutes. Graham's wife has been knitting cardigans in three sizes just in case. Graham himself has started restoring an old pram he found at a car boot sale. Ask Graham for news on Monday if I haven't heard.
Leon's running the Berlin marathon next autumn, training already. Also does crosswords religiously, the cryptic one.
How did Ivan's paternity leave meeting go? Meant to ask Thursday. Remind me to message Ivan tonight.

Long chat with Eva over lunch. She's 34 weeks and the baby's breech, so there's a scan Wednesday to see if it's turned. She's trying not to worry but obviously is. Her husband Kai is away with work until the end of the month, which isn't helping. Her mum's flying over from Gdansk early next month to help. I said I'd bring round dinner Friday. Eva's also gone deep into embroidery, doing tiny animals on the baby's vests, they're actually brilliant.
Lwazi plays chess online every night, rated about 1800. Wants a proper wooden board, could be a birthday idea.
Must renew the car insurance by the end of the week.
Heather is learning to crochet so she can make a christening shawl for her niece. Christening's sometime in the spring, not fixed yet.
Rang Marta. The baby came early, Tuesday night, little Sofia, 5lb 2oz. They're still in hospital for a few days. Don't forget to drop the hamper round once they're home.
Rohan's been made captain of his cricket club. Season doesn't start until April but he's already planning nets.
Isabel and Luis are getting the baby christened on the 14th, then lunch at Luis's mum's. Isabel's dad is coming over from Valencia for it. Should get a little silver something.

Dinner with Kai, Joe and Chloe last night. Kai's switched from guitar to drums, his neighbours hate him. Joe's going to Lisbon for a stag do next weekend. Chloe's waiting to hear back about the midwife job, interview was Monday. Chloe's pregnant herself, due in May, so the timing's funny. Remind me to ask her about the job sometime this week.
Sana said Hamza is reading Dune for the third time. Also he's terrible at sleeping since the baby arrived, poor guy.
Nothing much from the school run chat really, just weather and the roadworks.

Pieter Fischer, my old flatmate, messaged out of the blue. He and his wife Annika just had their second, a girl, last week. They've moved back to Utrecht. Should send something small and a proper card.
Dmitri's knee surgery is Thursday morning. He's nervous about the anaesthetic more than anything. Message him Thursday evening to see how it went.
Henrik's into fly fishing, ties his own flies in the winter. His son Oskar is learning too.
Karim mentioned his sister's due in a fortnight and he's already bought her baby about twelve football kits. Typical Karim. Barcelona, obviously.
Rebecca 'Becs' Dubois from the choir is expecting, found out at the weekend. She's still singing at the Christmas concert though, December 12th. Want to get her a little something before the concert.
Aidan cancelled the trip to Galway, Marta's too far along to fly now. They're doing a weekend in the Cotswolds instead, sometime next month.
Me and Leon are going to the darts at Ally Pally after Christmas. I'm sorting the tickets.

Neha's struggling a bit since the baby came, not sleeping, hardly leaving the house. Her husband Karim is back at work already. Her mum lives in Leicester so can't help much until after Christmas. I need to pop round with coffee sometime this week, and maybe take the baby for a walk so she can nap. Also remember she's coeliac when I bring cake.
Spoke to Stefan on the phone. His cat Pfeffer is having surgery on Monday for a lump, he's worried sick. Ask how she got on Tuesday.
Lukas has got really into sourdough, feeds the starter twice a day like it's a pet. Erin, his girlfriend, can't stand the smell lol.

Erin Brennan's waters broke at the pub quiz last night!! Baby arrived at 4am, a boy, Finn. Absolutely mad. Her partner Rohan drove like a lunatic apparently. Send congrats today and organise a meal rota with the others for next week.
Joe's daughter is doing her grade 3 piano exam early December. She's practising every day, he says she's calm about it.
Javier and his wife Isabel are thinking of trying for a baby after the summer. Not a secret but not public either. He's also getting into vinyl, mostly Brazilian jazz.
Need to book a dentist appointment and sort out the boiler service sometime next week.
Akira's wife Rin had the anomaly scan yesterday, all looks good. Baby's due late January. Akira's building a Lego Millennium Falcon for the nursery shelf, which is very Akira.
Paolo plays in a Sunday league, centre back. Supports Napoli, gets genuinely upset when they lose. His mum's 70th is early March, big party in Naples.
Hamza and Sana's little one, Yusuf, is being christened on Sunday the 9th. Actually it's an aqiqah, not a christening, I should get that right. Bring a gift for Yusuf.

Chatted with Graham at the allotment. He grows prize onions and enters the county show every August. His granddaughter is due any time and he's made a little wooden rocking horse for her. Also his wife's knee has been bad again, she's seeing a consultant next Wednesday.

Kemal's wife Heather is pregnant again, due around Easter. Their eldest, Deniz, starts reception in September. Kemal seemed knackered but happy. I must remember to ask Heather how the first scan went, it's next Thursday I think.
Ivan's into rally cars, watches every WRC stage. Wants to do a track day for his 40th next spring, good gift hint.
Eva's baby shower Saturday afternoon. I'm bringing the fruit platter.

Ran into Luis at the gym. He said Marta's sister had a baby girl last week, Marta's the godmother. The christening's sometime after Christmas. He's still doing his Japanese lessons, wants to go to Osaka in the autumn.

Lwazi's partner Chloe is pregnant, they told me today. She's 12 weeks, due in May. Lwazi's already researching prams like it's a degree. Remind me to drop off the baby books I've got in the loft sometime this month.
Rang Mum. Uncle Graham's had his heart scan, results in a fortnight. She's worried. Ring her again Sunday.
Rin and Akira have named the baby Hana! Arrived Monday. Need to get a card and something tiny, she loves the colour yellow.
Sana's knitting club meets Wednesdays, she's making a whole wardrobe for her nephew. Nephew's christening is end of the month.
Leon and his partner Kai are adopting, matching panel is next Tuesday. Leon's a nervous wreck, Kai's pretending to be calm. Text them both good luck on Monday night, then ask how it went Wednesday.
Neha's brother Rohan is moving to Toronto sometime in the new year for work. She's gutted. His wife's pregnant too so the timing is rough for the family.

Catch-up call with Paolo and Kemal about the five-a-side team. Paolo might have to step back for a bit, Heather's due early December and he wants to be around. Kemal reckons we can borrow his cousin Leon, who used to play semi-pro in Turkey. Kemal's also got really into darts, has a board in the garage now and practises every evening. We're all meeting for a curry next Friday to sort the spring fixtures. I should email the league about the change before then.
